title: AZ: named N1 N5 N6 browser and persisted-state acceptance
public_pr_body:
Adds three named real-browser acceptance specs using fresh synthetic companies. N1 saves both break rules through the page, reloads, reads stored settings and compares planned/clocked minutes. N5 checks empty business records and persistent own-company setup progress. N6 checks untouched legacy text, explicit exact-text saving and reload. Every case checks the other company's relevant state is unchanged.

Assumption: reviewed 145 is already present in the separately authorised isolated rehearsal; missing schema fails, never skips or auto-installs. Existing guarded browser global setup and synthetic cleanup retained. Playwright collection: 3 tests. Supporting units: 39 passed, 0 failed/skipped. TypeScript and changed-file ESLint passed. Browser/SQL runtime NOT RUN under no-SQL rule; these results are not acceptance proof. No production changes, docs files or external emails.
